verdict.rationale: Gazebo's own docs ship a headless server-only mode (-s) and a lightweight gz-sim10-server package explicitly described as being for headless and CI environments. Command-line tools for simulation control mean simulations can run unattended in CI pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence documents a test framework, fixtures, assertions, or a regression-testing workflow, so the testing part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented test harness or fixtures for simulation-based tests, regression or CI pipeline examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
